Axiom: Process depth is proportional to the declared SCALE: SCALE governs interview depth, the number of design alternatives explored, and the weight of the verification tail. SCALE becomes binding only after operator confirmation — the router proposes a default, the operator confirms or corrects it; a silently self-assessed scale is void. Branches read the confirmed `scale:` from the session file (`SESSION_FILE_FORMAT`) and size their process to it.
